title: Use the right restraints and protective equipment
advice: All vehicle occupants should wear seat belts. Two-wheeler riders should wear a properly fastened helmet.

title: Keep attention on the road
advice: Do not handle or read a phone while driving. Set navigation before departure and stop somewhere safe before changing it.

title: Adapt speed and following distance
advice: Follow posted speed limits and increase your following distance when visibility, traffic, or road grip is reduced.

title: Allow for wet-road conditions
advice: If rain is present, reduce speed, leave extra space for braking, and avoid sudden steering or braking.
source_title: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways: Road Safety

title: Treat poor visibility as a reason to slow down
advice: In fog, use low-beam headlights, avoid abrupt manoeuvres, and stop at a safe place if you cannot see far enough to drive safely.
source_title: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways: Road Safety

title: Do not enter a flooded road
advice: Do not drive through floodwater or around a road-closure barrier. Turn back and use an official diversion.
source_title: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways: Road Safety

title: Check official weather alerts
advice: Before departure, check current India Meteorological Department warnings for the places and time you expect to travel.

title: Follow incident controls, not the map alone
advice: If an incident or closure is reported, obey police and road-authority directions and confirm a safe diversion before continuing.
source_title: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways: Road Safety

title: Plan breaks for night driving
advice: If you feel drowsy, stop at a safe location and rest; do not rely on speed or open windows to stay alert.
source_title: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways: Road Safety
